how.title: Why this works
how.1: You answer first, then learn why. Trying to recall something, even when you get it wrong, makes it stick far better than re-reading.
how.2: Tell us if you're sure or guessing. Lucky guesses don't count as knowing, and confident mistakes get extra attention.
how.3: Facts come back right before you'd forget them. Easy ones fade away; hard ones keep showing up.
how.4: Topics are mixed together, and questions get harder as you improve: typed numbers and real-world scenarios instead of just picking a letter.
disclaimer: Free study aid, not affiliated with the {agency}. The official handbook and Idaho law always win. Check the handbook if anything here looks different.
fb.guessRight: Right — but you guessed, so we'll check again soon.
fb.guessWrong: Not quite. Good that you knew you weren't sure.
fb.sureWrong: Surprise! You were sure, but this one's different. These are the best mistakes to catch now — not at the DMV.
